abstract.para: The database includes records of mammals from the Polissia region of Ukraine (Volyn, Rivne, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Chernihiv and Sumy provinces) from scientific publications (1998-2018).

intellectualRights.para: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) 4.0 License.

geographicCoverage.geographicDescription: Polissia region of Ukraine (Volyn, Rivne, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Chernihiv and Sumy provinces).

taxonomicCoverage.generalTaxonomicCoverage: Information on occurence of 78 Mammalian species is provided.

contact.organizationName: Department of Animal Monitoring and Conservation, Schmalhausen Institute of Zoology

description.para: Highlighting mammal species occurrences in Polissia region of Ukraine from scientific publications (1998-2018)
Occurrence of animals was confirmed either by personal observations and studies or by using data that is already published in literature.

samplingDescription.para: Scientific publications devoted to mammalian fauna were used as a source of the dataset. In the course of original investigations live-trapping, pitfall trapping, camera trapping, analysis of owl pellets and direct observations were conducted.

description.para: Authors of the dataset are fully responsible for the correctness of species identifications, information on organisms' quantity and georeferencing.

project.title: Mobilization of biodiversity data from Ukraine to GBIF

abstract.para: Dataset has been organized with the support of Project nlbif2018.2019.004 funded by NLBIF to The Habitat Foundation "Mobilization of biodiversity data from Ukraine to GBIF"
